ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the PRC's list of politically exposed persons (PEPs), OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU restrictive measures, and Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission designated persons. Enhanced due diligence is required for shareholders, directors, and beneficial owners connected to government procurement or state-owned enterprises. Screening must run before incorporation, upon any UBO change, and periodically thereafter. Matches trigger suspension of formation and filing with the People's Bank of China anti-money-laundering bureau.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) at www.gsxt.gov.cn and the SAMR Name Independent Declaration System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Chinese enterprise names must be in simplified Chinese characters; no foreign letters, except the English name may be registered separately in the articles. Structure: administrative division (city/province) + trade name + industry/characteristic + organization form (Limited Liability Company). Pinyin or English transliteration cannot replace the Chinese name in the official registry. For the WFOE, the Chinese name must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing trademarks or enterprise names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name application is rejected, the applicant may, within 15 calendar days of the online rejection notice, file an administrative reconsideration petition with the same SAMR branch that issued the decision, or with the next higher authority. The petition must include the original name search report, a detailed dissimilarity analysis, and any prior-use evidence or trademark coexistence agreements. The authority must issue a written ruling within 10 working days of receiving the petition. Should the reconsideration fail, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit before the competent people's court under the Administrative Procedure Law. During the appeal, the name may not be used.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable for a WFOE engaged in hyper-casual games publishing. China's State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) and commercial banks require a physical business address for opening corporate bank accounts and for receiving periodic AdMob and AppLovin payouts. Tax authorities require an actual place of business for VAT registration and payroll. A registered address in a commercial office building, business incubator, or restricted-access co-working space with a dedicated lease and visited during office hours is acceptable. Virtual-only addresses risk de-registration and denial of treaty benefits. Recommended to lease a physical office of at least 10 square meters or use a legally recognized shared office with a virtual service provider that provides mail forwarding and physical inspection access.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) whether the nameplate is on the door, (2) whether employees are present during working hours, (3) whether books and records are accessible, (4) whether the lease term exceeds one year, (5) whether utility bills match the address. Unannounced inspections by municipal tax and market regulation authorities are moderately frequent for high-cash-flow digital publishers. Risk factor: Low to Medium (estimated 15% to 25% per year probability of a spot check). Mitigate by placing a valid lease, active signage, employee presence, and maintaining all original vouchers at the premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act of Taiwan (R.O.C.), as consolidated and amended, particularly Articles 7, 15, 18, 129, 130, 156, 172, 193, 208, 266, 387, 393 and 449, together with the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (Articles 5, 7, 8 and 12), the Regulations for Permission of Investment by Foreign Nationals, and the Company Registration Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan (R.O.C.), operating through the MOEA Company Registration System and coordinated with the MOEA Investment Commission for foreign-investment clearance.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign Investment Company Establishment Registration Package: Company Registration Application Form, attested Articles of Incorporation, Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, capital verification certificate or threshold exemption declaration, Foreign Investment Approval Letter, and statutory consents to act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a foreign-invested limited company under Taiwan's Companies Act for ISIC 5820 software publishing. The subscribers fix the initial paid-up capital in the Articles of Incorporation. The paid-in capital must be deposited in a Taiwan New Taiwan Dollar bank account and remitted through foreign exchange procedures; a certified public accountant capital verification certificate is required only if the paid-in capital exceeds the MOEA threshold. No escrow or blocked capital account requirement applies to this low-risk digital publishing entity.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 01 OF [●] COMPANY LIMITED (THE COMPANY) ADOPTED AT A DULY CONVENED MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS ON [DATE] AT [TIME], AT THE REGISTERED OFFICE. 1. CONVENING, QUORUM AND VALIDITY. The Chairman confirmed that written notice of the meeting had been served on every director entitled to notice on [date], or that every director had executed a waiver of notice, and that the directors present formed a quorum under the Articles of Incorporation and Article 208 of the Companies Act. The meeting was therefore validly convened and competent to transact the business set out below. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby established at [●], Taipei, Taiwan (R.O.C.), and that the Company Secretary be and is hereby authorized to register that address with the Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs, and to make any subsequent change as required by law. 3. SUBSCRIPTION AND ALLOTMENT OF SHARES. RESOLVED, that the authorized share capital of the Company be fixed at NT$[●], divided into [●] ordinary shares of NT$[●] each, and that the initial paid-up capital be NT$[●]. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the sole foreign shareholder has subscribed in cash for [●] ordinary shares at par, that the full subscription moneys have been received by the Company or duly deposited into a Taiwan banking account in the name of the Company as capital, and that such shares be and are hereby allotted fully paid and non-assessable. 4. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the Company establish banking relationships with [●] Bank, and that the Chairperson, the Chief Financial Officer, or any two directors acting jointly, be and are hereby authorized to open general, foreign currency, payroll and trust accounts, to sign banking mandates, to issue instructions for wire transfers and deposits, and to negotiate fees and credit facilities, with the express condition that all payments above NT$[●] require dual signatures. 5. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. RESOLVED, that [●] be appointed Chairperson, [●] be appointed General Manager and Chief Executive Officer, [●] be appointed Chief Financial Officer, and [●] be appointed Company Secretary, each to serve until adjournment of the next general meeting or earlier removal, with all powers granted under the Articles of Incorporation and the Companies Act. 6. DELEGATION AND FILING. RESOLVED, that the Chairperson, the General Manager, and the Company Secretary, acting together, be and are hereby authorized to execute and file the incorporation application, to obtain the certificate of incorporation and tax registration, to appoint lawyers and certified public accountants, to adopt a corporate seal, and to take all actions necessary to implement this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Inward Remittance Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA-IC), Taiwan (R.O.C.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the Investment Commission online application portal and submit the Foreign Investment Application. The application must state the full legal name and jurisdiction of the foreign investor, the exact amount of capital to be remitted, the source of funds, and the approved business scope, which shall be limited to ISIC 5820 software publishing and hyper-casual mobile game distribution, excluding regulated financial, telecommunications, or physical manufacturing activities. Annex the notarized corporate documents of the foreign shareholder and the power of attorney granted to the Taiwan resident agent. The MOEA-IC will verify outward remittance records through the Central Bank foreign exchange database and issue a Foreign Investment Approval Letter, which is a mandatory precondition for company registration.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form (MOEA-IC Form A/A-2)
Foreign investor certificate of incorporation and board resolution
Audited or certified financial statements of the foreign investor or bank reference letter
Source-of-funds statement and inward remittance undertaking
Power of attorney in favor of Taiwan local agent
Business plan for ISIC 5820 hyper-casual game publishing
Passport copy of ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA-IC issues a clarification request, the applicant has 60 days to respond through the portal; if the application is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days after the written decision, or submit a revised application with a completed business scope and a certified source of funds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Name Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Name Reservation System, Department of Commercial Services, MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the MOEA Department of Commercial Services Company Name Reservation System and file an application to reserve the English and legal transliterated name of the WFOE. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any registered company, trademark, or institution in Taiwan, must contain no restricted words such as bank, insurance, or securities unless a special license is held, and must indicate limited liability status. Submit the MOEA-IC foreign investment approval number as the reference. The registry will run an automated similarity search across the national company database and issue a Name Reservation Certificate valid for six months, renewable once. Use the reserved name in all subsequent incorporation documents and filings.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application online
MOEA-IC foreign investment approval reference number
Proposed English and transliterated company name
List of restricted words and similarity search report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is refused for similarity, the applicant may immediately submit up to five alternative names online; there is no substantive appeal but the reservation fee is retained, and re-filing with a new distinctive name can cure the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit, Execution of Articles, and Statutory Incorporation Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, MOEA; licensed domestic bank; certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name reservation and foreign investment approval, the sole foreign shareholder executes the Articles of Incorporation in Taiwan, and the Board adopts the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution. The paid-up capital, in New Taiwan Dollars, must be deposited into a capital account at a licensed bank using the approved inward remittance; if paid-in capital exceeds the MOEA threshold, a certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report. Submission is then made through the MOEA Company Registration online system, attaching the reserved-name certificate, foreign investment approval, articles of incorporation, resolution, capital report, registered-office consent, and director identity documents. The MOEA reviews for legal validity, business-scope conformity, and mandatory statutory contents and, if satisfied, issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Attested Articles of Incorporation
Pro-Forma First Board Resolution
Foreign Investment Approval Letter
Capital verification report or threshold exemption declaration
Bank capital deposit certificate and inward remittance advice
Registered office lease and landlord consent
Consent to act from each director and statutory officer
Name Reservation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a notice of rectification, correct the defect within 30 days by online supplementary filing; if the registration is denied, re-file the entire package after curing the irregularity, or appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days under the Administrative Appeal Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor, Payroll, and Workplace Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance; Labor Insurance Administration, Ministry of Labor; local labor inspection office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within fifteen days after the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, the company or its authorized agent must apply to the National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise tax registration, business tax registration, and payroll withholding registration. The tax clearance officer will verify the company address, seal impression, directors, shareholders, and business scope before issuing the Unified Business Tax Identification Number. Simultaneously, the company must register as an employer with the Labor Insurance Administration for labor insurance and labor pension contributions, and with the local labor inspection office for workplace safety notification. The company should also apply for an electronic invoice system through the taxation bureau integrated platform.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Unified Business Tax Identification registration form
Company seal impression card
Articles of Incorporation and first board resolution
Registered office lease and business tax questionnaire
Director and shareholder identification documents
Payroll, labor insurance, and labor pension registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is rejected or delayed, submit the missing documents through the online tax portal, pay the statutory late filing fee if applicable, and request a written reason for refusal; an administrative review may be requested within 30 days of the notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Activation, Statutory Books, and Corporate Governance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed domestic bank; MOEA Company Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On issuance of the tax identification number, the directors responsible for banking are required to appear at the designated bank with the original Certificate of Incorporation, the tax registration certificate, the board resolution approving signatories, the Taiwan local agent passport or Alien Resident Certificate, and a corporate KYC and beneficial ownership declaration. The bank will execute the account mandate and may conduct enhanced due diligence on the ultimate foreign investor; however, because hyper-casual game publishing is classified as low AML risk, standard KYC will normally apply. After the account is opened, the Company Secretary must file any notice of statutory officer changes, maintain the register of shareholders, minutes, and seals, and publish the incorporation information on the MOEA national database.
required_dossiers: Board resolution approving bank mandates and dual-signature control
Certificate of Incorporation and tax registration certificate
KYC and beneficial ownership declaration
Passport or Alien Resident Certificate of directors and local agent
Corporate governance forms and register of shareholders template
Registered office utility bill or lease proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further KYC information, provide the corporate chart, audited financial statements, and source-of-wealth letter; if the bank maintains refusal, open an account with an alternative licensed bank and notify MOEA of the final banking mandate within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - ISIC 5820 software publishing is a pure digital service activity; no industrial licensing board, manufacturing permit, or physical plant authority is engaged in this formation. The only commercial registration authority is the Department of Commercial Services, MOEA.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial operating license or factory registration is required for hyper-casual mobile game publishing and digital ad-monetization under Taiwan Factory Act or industrial development regulations. If the company later adds physical manufacturing or warehousing, a separate factory registration license and municipal business permit would be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Taiwan Ministry of Environment would have jurisdiction only if a fixed pollution source is installed; none exists for ISIC 5820.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA Report, self-assessment, or environmental registration is required for a software publishing office without manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero production wastewater, zero regulated VOC emissions, and zero hazardous waste generation are expected; standard municipal wastewater and general office waste disposal requirements apply, and any future data-center or physical operation would trigger separate energy and waste permitting.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable as an industrial civil-defense fire permit; however, the registered office must still pass a routine building safety inspection and fire-safety examination under Taiwan Fire Services Act before occupancy, maintain fire extinguishers, exit paths, and panic lighting, and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act for office workers. A formal subject-matter fire safety certificate is not required because the premises are not classified as an industrial or dangerous-material facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); electronic tax filings and VAT administration are conducted through the nationwide Electronic Tax Service Platform (e-Tax) and the STA e-invoice service system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Taiwan-resident investor incorporates the WFOE in mainland China and applies to the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) for a Business License containing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the legal person's statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN). The company's legal representative and financial officer must then, within 30 calendar days of the Business License issuance date, log into the Electronic Tax Service Platform and complete the tax registration by submitting the business license, articles of association, investor resolutions, registered address lease agreement, bank open account certificate, and passport/company registration certificate of the non-resident shareholder. Upon approval, the tax authority issues the tax registration record and activates the VAT taxpayer profile (small-scale or general). A non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China must separately complete non-resident registration for withholding tax and VAT reporting using the STA-issued Tax Identification Number for non-residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None - China does not provide check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections; the WFOE is mandatorily treated as a PRC resident enterprise subject to Enterprise Income Tax at a 25% statutory rate on worldwide income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover for mandatory General VAT Taxpayer registration; basic tax registration is required from the date of establishment with no turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China enforces a real-time fiscal clearance regime under the Golden Tax Phase IV system and the all-electronic Fapiao platform. All VAT invoices must be issued through the STA-approved tax control UKey or the national e-invoice service platform, transmitted electronically to the tax authority in near real time, digitally signed with a QR code encryption stamp, and reconciled with customs declarations, bank fund flows, and contract records under the invoice-flow-fund matching audit mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A general VAT taxpayer may claim the 0% export VAT rate where: (i) physical goods are exported beyond mainland China's customs territory with a customs export declaration; or (ii) qualifying digital services, including hyper-casual mobile game publishing, online platform advertising, and software-enabled content, are supplied to a non-PRC customer and consumed entirely outside mainland China, with the contract, server logs, and payment records confirming off-shore consumption. The privilege requires the exporter to be a registered VAT general taxpayer, to actually receive foreign exchange from outside mainland China, and to maintain a complete statutory documentation file substantiating the cross-border supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Goods Customs Declaration Form (Customs Export Declaration)
Carrier-issued Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment outside mainland China
Commercial Invoice and Packing List issued by the exporting WFOE
Bank Export Proceeds Receipt Voucher or Foreign Exchange Settlement Certificate issued by a State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)-designated bank
Cross-Border Service Contract, server/usage logs, and evidence of payment by the overseas counterparty for zero-rated digital services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authorities may retrospectively disallow export zero-rating if the statutory documentation is incomplete, inauthentic, or inconsistent with bank fund flows, in which case VAT is clawed back at the applicable rate (13% for goods, 6% for services), late surcharges accrue at 0.05% per day, and an administrative penalty of 50% to five times the underpaid tax may be imposed under the PRC Tax Administration Law. Deliberate false export declarations constitute tax fraud and criminal tax evasion, resulting in cancellation of export tax rebate qualifications, inclusion on the tax blacklist, seizure of refundable input VAT, and exposure to criminal prosecution for the responsible personnel.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The jurisdiction relevant to this WFOE treasury blueprint is the People's Republic of China, whose currency is the Renminbi (RMB). Mainland China operates under a managed floating exchange rate regime with strict foreign exchange controls administered by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE). The current account is generally convertible subject to genuine trade and service transaction verification, while the capital account remains heavily regulated. A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) in the software and digital gaming publishing sector must ensure that all inbound equity injections are properly recorded under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting system and routed through a designated Renminbi or Foreign Currency Capital Account. Outbound profit remittances require audited financial statements, a tax clearance certificate, and evidence that the distributable profits were generated from verified operational revenue. For a hyper-casual gaming publisher, significant revenue may arrive as cross-border digital advertising payouts from platforms such as AdMob and AppLovin, which are classified as services under current account. These service receipts may require lodging with a domestic bank under a service trade contract, supporting invoices, and proof of digital platform earnings. SAFE will screen such receipts for beneficial ownership and the genuineness of the underlying digital advertising activity. Surrender requirements historically applied to export proceeds but have been abolished for current account receipts since 2012; however banks will still verify the economic substance of service export revenue to curb disguised capital flows. Profit repatriation is permitted once corporate income tax and statutory reserves are satisfied, but the burden of proof is substantial. Any delay or mismatch in documentation can trigger a Suspicious Transaction Report and freeze the payout. Therefore, the treasury strategy must prioritize documentation automation, bank relationship custody, and rigorous reconciliation between platform payout statements and underlying game publishing contracts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: As of the current SAFE framework, mandatory export proceeds surrender requirements have been effectively abolished for current account receipts. The WFOE is allowed to retain export service proceeds in foreign currency or convert them into Renminbi at its chosen bank. However, banks are obliged to perform the 'reasonable authenticity and consistency' review under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations. For digital advertising and game publishing service revenue, the entity must submit the digital platform payout statement, executed service agreements, and a breakdown of user platform geography within five working days if requested. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio; conversion is at the discretion of the entity. The more relevant statutory timeline is the six-month period for capital account settlement of foreign currency capital, and the requirement to use the Foreign Capital to Foreign Debt Conversion System for any capital injection payment. For current account advertising receipts, the bank will typically credit and permit conversion within the same business day once the transaction is matched against the annual service trade quota. The WFOE must also update the tax filing for the corresponding offshore digital platform fees, as under-remittance can trigger a transfer pricing audit.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Non-feasible for core settlement in the CN jurisdiction. Offshore fintech EMIs and digital-only banks are not licensed to hold RMB current accounts or provide foreign exchange conversion services directly to mainland WFOE entities. The WFOE is required to maintain an onshore banking relationship with a SAFE-designated commercial bank for all capital account receipts, injection verification, profit repatriation and service trade payables. Offshore EMIs can only be used as auxiliary collection nodes for low-value foreign advertising revenue if supported by a licensed payment institution in China, but this introduces a higher AML risk profile and is discouraged. The compliance committee should reject any EMI-centric treasury design.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in-branch appearance is required for the statutory legal representative and the primary beneficial owner during account opening for a WFOE. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted by major domestic banks for capital account opening. For the initial onboarding interview, the legal representative must appear at the bank branch in the jurisdiction of the WFOE's registered address, carrying original passport or Chinese ID, business license, foreign investment information report confirmation, articles of association, and the SAFE registration certificate. Some banks may permit a secondary operational signatory to be authenticated under a power of attorney after the legal representative has completed the inaugural interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) opacity around the Taiwan shareholder and layered corporate chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Association of all entities in the ownership chain up to the natural person; a notarized organogram showing direct and indirect shareholding; passport or ID copies of the UBO; bank introduction letter from the Taiwan shareholder's banking relationship manager with a statement confirming source of funding for the WFOE share capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Hyper-casual mobile gaming revenue model judged as intangible digital service flows lacking physical product evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed digital ad monetization agreements with AdMob and AppLovin; monthly payout statements from each ad network for the previous twelve months; a certified public accountant's review opinion on the gaming application programming interface (API) dashboards and ad server logs; a technical flowchart showing how virtual ad impressions convert to receivable entries; and export service declaration records for the gaming services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between registered business scope and cross-border payment volume due to rapid user scaling
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amended business license covering ISIC 5820 and online game publishing; an internal financial forecast explaining the revenue spike; platform user geography reports showing no sanctions-affected or high-risk trafficking jurisdictions; and evidence that in-app purchases are processed through compliant app stores such as Apple App Store and Google Play.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential violation of unverified crypto or virtual asset settlement for ad revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements from the entity's Taiwan treasury accounts showing legal fiat denominated transfers; a written undertaking that no cryptocurrency, stablecoin or unlicensed virtual asset payment instrument is involved in settlement; and a transaction monitoring policy prepared by the AML compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan shareholder must remit the WFOE registered capital from its domestic Taiwanese NT dollar account through an authorized Taiwanese remitting bank, converting to USD or directly to RMB via the China Foreign Exchange Trade System rate. The remittance must state the purpose code as 'Investment / Registered Capital – Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise capital injection' and include the WFOE Foreign Investment Code (FDI code) in the remittance instruction. The inbound wire should arrive at the Bank of China capital escrow account using SWIFT MT103, with supporting equity transfer agreement or board resolution proving ownership. Within fifteen calendar days of receipt, the bank must settle the foreign currency into RMB using the FDI Foreign Exchange Settlement system and verify the transaction against the annual foreign investment information report. The WFOE must also complete tax registration with the local tax authority and apply for a capital verification report issued by a Chinese certified public accountant if the banks or future lenders require it. No borrowing, third-party 27 letters of credit transfer, or set-off against unrelated trade receivables is permitted on the capital account before settlement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound disbursements related to international game publishing operations and advertising supply, the WFOE should use domestic and cross-border clearing rails in the following order of preference: SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments and international licensing fees, Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) only for tangible physical equipment acquisition where the corporate banking relationship provides full documentary support, and Documentary Collections (D/P or D/A) where the counterparty is a recurring trusted vendor and the transaction value is material. For recurring ad network payouts, the entity should contract with a SAFE-registered third-party payment institution for bulk payments into overseas developer accounts, but must retain a segregated audit trail showing the corresponding advertising revenue invoice and tax deduction certificates. All outbound remittances must be tagged with the applicable SAFE payment purpose code, such as code 122010 for royalties and license fees or code 121010 for software export services. The bank will require the underlying contract, invoice, proof of service delivery in the form of downloadable server access logs, and withholding tax payment voucher, where applicable, before clearing the cross-border Instruction. For trade settlement, the WFOE should maintain separate accounts for RMB capital settlement and operational current account to avoid mistakenly pulling funds from the frozen capital account into general working capital.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign exchange contracts between RMB and USD up to 12 months tenor with a licensed onshore Chinese bank, supported by a genuine exposure of future advertising receivables or royalty payables.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for USD/TWD and USD/RMB exposures, executed only through an onshore bank's offshore booking desk to the extent permitted for the WFOE's hedging program, with documentation proving the purpose is economic hedging rather than speculative.

Cross-currency swaps strictly limited to converting USD loan or capital injection principal into RMB at swap maturity for the duration of the actual equity funding plan, with board authorization and SAFE registration where applicable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Settlement Return (年度營利事業所得稅結算申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (各地區國稅局)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the following calendar year; one-month extension to June 30 if filed by a licensed CPA tax agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 3% of the underpaid tax for each 3-day delay, capped at 30 days; thereafter interest at 0.15% per month; mandatory tax assessment plus penalty of up to 3x underpaid tax for non-filing; sustained non-compliance triggers administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting Resolution and Approved Financial Statements (年度股東常會決議及財務報表)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders; Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs (經濟部商業司) for record in company registration dossier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the fiscal year end, i.e., no later than June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene may trigger a fine of TWD 200,000 (approx. USD 6,500) on the responsible director; continued avoidance of statutory meeting may lead to discretionary dissolution by the authority.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Performance Report (投資事業年度營運報告)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議司)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31; the period may be extended to June 30 upon prior application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate filing may result in an administrative fine of TWD 30,000–150,000 (approx. USD 1,000–5,000) and suspension of future foreign investment application privileges.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner and Corporate Register Confirmation (年度最終受益人申報確認)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Information System (經濟部商工登記公示資料查詢服務)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30; changes made during the year must be reported within 15 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty of up to TWD 500,000 (approx. USD 16,000) for failing to register or update ultimate beneficial owners; repeated non-compliance may lead to deregistration or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Taiwan limited company is required to obtain a certified public accountant (CPA) audit of financial statements if paid-in capital exceeds TWD 30 million (approx. USD 950,000) or if revenue exceeds TWD 100 million (approx. USD 3.2 million); investment-commission approved foreign-owned enterprises are also required to submit audited financial statements regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: ROC GAAP as aligned with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); for unlisted private companies, the IFRS for SMEs framework is permitted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every company must record ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and senior management in the company's internal register; any share transfer, director change, or UBO variation must be reported to MOEA within 15 days; an annual confirmation statement is submitted each calendar year by June 30 to validate the registered data as at the preceding fiscal year end.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (最終受益人名冊)
Minutes of Shareholders' Meetings (股東會議事錄)
Minutes of Board Meetings (董事會議事錄)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 – USD 3,500 per annum for a licensed corporate service provider and registered office in Taipei
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 – USD 18,000 per annum depending on transaction volume and number of gaming platform payouts (AdMob/AppLovin)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualified Software Enterprise: two-year CIT exemption, next three years at 50% reduction (12.5%); High/New-Technology Enterprise: 15% preferential rate; R&D expense super deduction: 100% additional deduction (total 200% deduction).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Prepayment Return (Form A200000, Class A) filed via China's Electronic Tax Administration portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; Q4 prepayment due by 15 January of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report quarterly pre-tax profit under PRC Accounting Standards; include hyper-casual game publishing revenue from ad platforms such as AdMob and AppLovin.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident WFOE aggregates worldwide income; do not consolidate the Taiwan parent's income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2: Tax adjustments and loss carryforwards
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjust temporary differences, carryforward prior-year losses, and apply any preferential tax treatment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party adjustments must be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing evidence; maintain documentation for cross-border payments to Taiwan.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculate current quarter tax at 25% or applicable preferential rate; remit to the central treasury.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty relief on dividend withholding does not affect quarterly CIT prepayment, but record all non-resident remittances.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine of RMB 2,000-10,000 (serious cases: RMB 10,000-50,000); daily late payment surcharge of 0.05% on overdue tax; compulsory enforcement for persistent non-compliance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form A100000) with schedules A105000, A105050, and A108000; filed via the same ETS portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end; extensions require tax authority approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross advertising revenue and net game publishing revenue; reconcile with foreign platform settlement statements from AdMob and AppLovin.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure cross-border platform income is fully booked and matches foreign exchange settlement records; disclose all related-party platform agreements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Include R&D salaries, server costs, user acquisition, amortized intellectual property licenses, royalty payments, and administrative overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Royalty and interest paid to Taiwan parent must be at arm's length and supported by TP documentation; intellectual property charges must pass the benefit test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Arrive at taxable income after loss carryforwards, adjustments, and software enterprise tax holidays; if the WFOE claims the software holiday, report exempt and halved-profit periods accurately.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate and substantiate expenses attributable to treaty-exempt or preferential income; non-resident parent cannot claim direct deductions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List all related-party relationships and controlled transactions with the Taiwan parent and sister companies, including IP licensing, services, loans, and ad revenue sharing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation if thresholds are met; provide beneficial ownership statement for treaty relief on cross-border remittances.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine of RMB 2,000-10,000 (serious: RMB 10,000-50,000); daily 0.05% surcharge; travel bans on legal representative for flagrant non-payment; criminal liability for fraudulent filings.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed to a Taiwan non-resident enterprise (withheld under EIT Law Art. 37); reduced to 5% under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement if the Taiwan parent directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE's capital and meets beneficial ownership conditions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the 5% treaty rate, the Taiwan parent must (1) obtain a Taiwan Tax Resident Certificate (TRC); (2) submit a Beneficial Ownership Self-Declaration and the Cross-Strait Dividend Treaty Relief Form to the competent PRC tax authority; (3) provide shareholding registry evidence demonstrating direct 25%+ ownership; (4) obtain approval before remittance; over-withheld amounts may be refunded via supplementary filing within five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 10% for both royalties and interest; the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement limits both to 10%, thus providing no reduction. A Taiwan licensor/lender with no PRC permanent establishment is subject to 10% tax on gross royalties and interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if annual related-party transactions exceed: RMB 100M for tangible asset transfers; RMB 100M for financial asset transfers; RMB 30M for intangible asset transfers or licensing; RMB 40M for service transactions; RMB 100M for other transactions. Master File required if total cross-border related-party transactions in the prior year exceed RMB 1B.
